Game Overview

Super Ninja Plumber puts players into a arcade experience centered on transform from plumber to ninja in a vibrant pixel world. Battle your way through thrilling levels, mastering agility and strategy to defeat fearsome stone bosses. With retro tunes setting the mood, embark on an adventurous journey filled with enchanting challenges and high-paced action.
